title and abstract.summary: The study measured the taxonomic and functional diversity, as well as the variation in functional traits and diversity, among leaf-litter dwelling ants across different areas and seasons in the tropical dry forest of the Colombian Caribbean.

introduction.summary: The study evaluates the spatial and temporal variation in taxonomic diversity and functional groups of ants in tropical dry forest fragments distributed in the northwestern Colombian Caribbean, and explores the variation in functional traits and diversity among these ant communities.
